name: dash-frontend
description: Frontend application for the DASH platform
author: Francisco Aranda <farandal@gmail.com>

scripts.dev:pinoywok:ngrok: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=pinoywok.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && cd apps/dash && yarn dev:pinoywok:ngrok
scripts.dev:kitchntabs:ngrok: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && cd apps/dash && yarn dev:kitchntabs:ngrok
scripts.dev:kitchntabs:production: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=web PLATFORM=web NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && cd apps/dash && yarn dev:kitchntabs:production
scripts.dev:android:kitchntabs:ngrok: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && turbo build && cap run android
scripts.dev:android:kitchntabs:production: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && turbo build && cap run android
scripts.release:android:kitchntabs:production: NODE_ENV=production turbo build && cap sync android && cd ./android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:dev: cross-env MODE=development CUSTOM_MODE=pinoywok.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js && turbo build && cap run android
scripts.android:prod: NODE_ENV=production turbo build && cap run android
scripts.android:bundle: NODE_ENV=production turbo build && cap sync android && cd ./android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.electron-dev:local: vite build -c electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_ENV=dev concurrently "cd apps/dash && yarn dev:desktop:local &" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3006 && electron ."
scripts.electron-dev:prod: vite build -c electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_ENV=prod concurrently "cd apps/dash && yarn dev:desktop:prod &" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3006 && electron ."
scripts.electron-prod: electron-icon-builder --input=./apps/dash/src/assets/logo-squared.png --output=./  && cross-env BUILD_ENV=prod IS_ELECTRON=true vite build -c electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=prod IS_ELECTRON=true yarn build &&  electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.electron-dev-win: vite build -c electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development BUILD_ENV=dev concurrently --kill-others --raw "cd apps/dash && yarn dev-win" "wait-on -v http://127.0.0.1:3006 && electron ."
scripts.electron-prod-win: electron-icon-builder --input=./apps/dash/src/assets/logo-squared.png --output=./ && yarn build-win &&  cross-env NODE_ENV=production BUILD_ENV=prod IS_ELECTRON=true vite build -c electron.vite.config.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.build:config:production:web:kitchntabs: cross-env MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=desktop PLATFORM=web NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js
scripts.build:config:android:kitchntabs: cross-env MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=kitchntabs.production TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js
scripts.build:config:android:ngrok: cross-env MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=pinoywok.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js
scripts.build:config:android:prod: cross-env MODE=production CUSTOM_MODE=pinoywok.ngrok TARGET_TYPE=mobile PLATFORM=android NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4048 node build_config.js
